description: The role a deprecated API plays, and lexical patterns for the mechanisms an Android repository can already be using for that role. migration_grounding.py counts these mechanisms in the checkout so a migration can follow the maintainers' own idiom. Adding a deprecated API means adding its fully qualified name to applies_to of the role it plays; adding a mechanism means adding its patterns. The patterns decide nothing: they only locate existing code a reviewer can read. `guarantees` names what a mechanism provides, `requires` in documented_semantics names what an invariant needs, and `platform` marks a mechanism that is available without a new dependency (JDK or Android framework), so it can be recommended even when the repository does not use it yet. A mechanism's guarantees are only what the mechanism itself documents; a repository helper has none here, and its behaviour is read from its implementation instead.

roles.summary: Run work off the main thread and deliver its result, progress or cancellation back on the main thread.

documented_semantics.invariant: execute(Params...) runs doInBackground on one background thread shared by every AsyncTask in the process, so tasks run one at a time in submission order. A replacement that runs them concurrently changes ordering and contention and must say so.
A task instance can be executed only once; a second execute throws IllegalStateException.
executeOnExecutor(executor, ...) runs doInBackground on the executor passed; THREAD_POOL_EXECUTOR runs tasks in parallel.

An exception thrown from doInBackground is rethrown on the worker thread ("An error occurred while executing doInBackground()") and terminates the process. A replacement must not silently discard it, for example by submitting to an executor and never reading the Future.
onPostExecute runs on the main thread with the result of doInBackground, and is not invoked for a cancelled task (onCancelled is invoked instead).
cancel(true) interrupts the thread running doInBackground and guarantees onPostExecute is not called afterwards, even for a result already computed.

mechanisms.name: java.util.concurrent executor
mechanisms.guarantees_note: Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor() runs tasks one at a time in submission order; Future.cancel(true) interrupts the running task; ThreadPoolExecutor clears a worker's interrupt status before running its next task.

mechanisms.name: main-thread Handler or runOnUiThread
mechanisms.guarantees_note: Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).post runs the runnable on the main thread.

mechanisms.name: Kotlin coroutines
mechanisms.guarantees_note: A Job cancels its coroutine; Dispatchers.Main dispatches to the main thread. Serial execution needs an explicitly single-threaded dispatcher.

mechanisms.name: project background-thread helper
mechanisms.guarantees_note: A repository or library helper guarantees nothing by catalogue; its behaviour is read from its implementation.

mechanisms.name: WorkManager
mechanisms.guarantees_note: Scheduled, persistable work; not an in-process ordered queue and not a main-thread result channel.

mechanisms.name: RxJava schedulers
mechanisms.guarantees_note: Disposable cancels the subscription; main-thread delivery needs RxAndroid's AndroidSchedulers.mainThread().

roles.summary: Deliver an event from one component to observers inside the same process.

documented_semantics.invariant: sendBroadcast returns immediately; matching receivers are invoked later on the application's main thread, not on the sender's thread.
sendBroadcastSync blocks and dispatches to every matching receiver before it returns.
A receiver is invoked only while registered; after unregisterReceiver it receives nothing, including broadcasts sent before but not yet delivered.

mechanisms.name: LiveData
mechanisms.guarantees_note: Observers are called on the main thread and only while their lifecycle is active; removeObserver stops delivery. LiveData keeps the latest value and replays it to new observers.

mechanisms.name: Kotlin Flow
mechanisms.guarantees_note: Cancelling the collecting coroutine stops delivery; the collector's dispatcher decides the thread.

mechanisms.name: listener interface registry
mechanisms.guarantees_note: A repository-defined registry guarantees what its implementation does; read it before relying on thread or ordering behaviour.

mechanisms.name: event bus
mechanisms.guarantees_note: unregister stops delivery; the subscriber's ThreadMode decides the thread.

mechanisms.name: Rx subjects
mechanisms.guarantees_note: Disposing the subscription stops delivery; observeOn decides the thread.
